title: NRCH + AMB+ flock replicates on seed 3: more, more uniform droplets with AMB+ and reaction (20 vs 7, CV 0.53 vs 0.78), polar order 0.89/0.81, no persistent splits
summary: Fresh seed 3, two of the four arms (192^2, t=6000), measured with the author's arms.py readout (arms_s3.py). Both terms (world.py defaults): late droplet count 20.0, CV of area 0.53, polar order 0.89; labkit 20 tracks >= 1 BL (max 23.5 BL), 44 splits, 0 persistent, 18 merges. Plain NRCH (lam=zeta=u=0): 7.0 droplets, CV 0.78, polar order 0.81; 7 tracks >= 1 BL (max 15.1 BL), 8 splits, 0 persistent. Droplets nucleate at t~1550-1800 as crescents and swim aligned (both/sheet.png).

observations.F: arms_s3.txt: both 20.0 / 0.53 / 0.89 vs plain 7.0 / 0.78 / 0.81; 0 persistent splits in both; both/sheet.png

verdicts.limitation: Only two of four arms re-run (not reaction-only or AMB+-only) and no static twins for the polar-order baseline.
